{{Quote|Humans on Taris did as they do on all other planets. They seized the surface, claimed Taris’s wealth and forced every other species underground. Every meter of land owned by a human was probably seized by another human, just as this was seized from my ancestors.|Achitan|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Achitan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] who lived on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She led a group of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] who reclaimed the Poh family estate on Taris, which in actuality had belonged to her family before [[Human/Legends|Humans]] ever arrived on Taris. She presented the documents to the traveling hero sent by [[Relus Poh]] and [[Jaymizu Poh]] to clear out the estate, and the hero returned with the documents to the Pohs to prove that Achitan and her group had a more legitimate claim. The Pohs acknowledged her claim, and accepted the fact that Achitan owned the land.<ref name="TOR" />
